sentence_stem: Although the report was written in very simple language,
correct_completion: many readers found its conclusions hard to follow.
full_sentence: Although the report was written in very simple language, many readers found its conclusions hard to follow.
acceptable_variants: some readers still found the main ideas difficult to understand.
its key points were not clear to a lot of people.

options.text: so everyone understood its main points easily.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result, not a contrast. After 'although' the sentence needs a clause that contrasts with the simple language mentioned in the stem.

options.text: the authors added several charts and tables.
options.why_wrong: This adds extra information but does not contrast with the simple language mentioned in the stem.

options.text: many readers found its conclusions hard to follow.
it was published in three different languages.
options.why_wrong: This is an unrelated fact about publication; it does not contrast with the difficulty expected after 'although'.

explanation: After 'although', the main clause must show a contrast with the first part of the sentence. Simple language normally suggests easy understanding, so the correct clause reverses that expectation.
